headline: Going Commando's USA v1.01 reaches 65.83% matched code after an 842-function carry-over
summary: Going Commando's USA v1.01 rises from 54.46% to 65.83% matched code, with 7,100 of 8,578 functions. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The largest addition brings 842 boot and level implementations from bigbeno37's fork (#368), after reviewed contributor work lands through #366 and #364. The final progress update separately records Europe/Australia at 4,979 of 8,672 functions and USA v2.00 at 6,646 of 8,634.
highlights: #366 reconciles overlapping contributions instead of counting every submitted function. One proposed hit-vector routine remains a near miss because of its initialisation order.
#362 improves a documented near miss but adds no match. Object-slot and held-object implementations in #370 and #371 open without merging.
Parallel builds now give simultaneously built programs separate Wine prefixes, removing a single shared wineserver bottleneck. An explicit `WINEPREFIX` retains the old arrangement.
#369 corrects the separate fully linked-code measure to sum complete units. That measure is distinct from matched-code coverage.
